title: Community Rules | Hynoe
heading: 1. Treat people like people
text: No targeted harassment, stalking, repeated unwanted contact, or coordinated pile-ons. No hateful attacks or dehumanizing abuse based on protected characteristics. No credible threats, encouragement of real-world violence, or attempts to intimidate someone into fearing for their safety.

title: Community Rules | Hynoe
heading: 2. Protect minors
text: No sexual content involving minors, grooming, exploitation, solicitation, or attempts to move minors into unsafe private interactions. Do not ask younger users for private identifying information. Account-backed public identity/social features are planned as 18+ at initial launch; local-only Hynoe Outpost remains available without an account.

title: Community Rules | Hynoe
heading: 3. Keep private information private
text: No doxxing, posting another person's address, phone number, private email, government identifiers, passwords, tokens, private logs, or other non-public personal information without permission. Do not pressure users to reveal their real name, exact location, school, workplace, or other private details. Privacy/security reports belong in a private channel, not public chat.

title: Community Rules | Hynoe
heading: 4. No scams, impersonation, or malicious links
text: Do not impersonate Hynoe staff, moderators, creators, or other users to deceive people. No phishing, malware, credential theft, fraudulent giveaways, fake payment requests, or intentionally deceptive links. Do not falsely claim that Hynoe, Mojang, Microsoft, or another company endorses a product or transaction.

title: Community Rules | Hynoe
heading: 5. Play fair in shared systems
text: Do not exploit bugs, tamper with score submissions, forge public leaderboard results, attack APIs, or use automation to disrupt shared systems. Report serious exploits privately so they can be fixed instead of teaching others how to abuse them. Accessibility tools and normal client/device features are not cheating merely because they make interaction easier.

title: Community Rules | Hynoe
heading: 6. Content and spam
text: No flooding, repeated spam, disruptive advertising, or content intended mainly to make a channel unusable. Keep sexual or graphic content out of Hynoe spaces unless a future space explicitly allows lawful age-restricted content; current general community spaces do not. Respect copyright and other creators' rights. Do not use Hynoe spaces to distribute obviously pirated or stolen material.

title: Community Rules | Hynoe
heading: 7. Moderation
text: Moderators may remove content, warn users, mute/restrict features, or ban access to Hynoe-controlled spaces when reasonably needed for these rules, security, legal obligations, or community safety. Moderation decisions may consider context, severity, repetition, credible evidence, and risk to others. Do not evade a Hynoe ban or restriction by creating alternate identities or asking someone else to act for you.

title: Community Rules | Hynoe
heading: 8. Reporting
text: Use the official Hynoe Discord linked from hynoesmp.com to contact moderators. For privacy, child-safety, threats, or security matters, ask for a private conversation and avoid reposting sensitive material publicly. Independent Minecraft community: Minecraft, Mojang, and Microsoft names and marks belong to their respective owners. Hynoe SMP is independent and is not affiliated with Mojang or Microsoft.

title: Community Rules | Hynoe
heading: Community rules
text: Hynoe should feel competitive, funny, social, and alive without becoming unsafe or impossible to moderate. These rules apply to Hynoe-controlled community features when they are enabled, and may also be used as the baseline for Hynoe SMP/Discord moderation. Website chat status: The website chat relay is not active right now. These rules are being published before broader social features are turned on.

title: Hynoe SMP Progression Guide | Campaign, Genesis Ages & Gear
heading: Your character has to earn access to the world.
text: Genesis sits underneath Hynoe SMP's gear ladder. Some unlocks are based on time played ; others require you to use a previous tier, clear a challenge, or complete a Story Age. That is why a recipe, item, furnace, armor set, or dimension can still be unavailable even when you know it exists. CORE RULE OWNING IT ≠ UNLOCKING IT Progress the Age itself. Do not assume another player handing you an item will bypass the gate. TOOLS ARMOR SKILLS STORY TOOL AGES

title: Hynoe SMP Progression Guide | Campaign, Genesis Ages & Gear
heading: Use the tier before you graduate from it.
text: Tool progression is built around actually exhausting each material tier instead of crafting one pickaxe and instantly skipping ahead. START Wood Available immediately → BREAK WOOD TOOL Stone Unlock stone tools → BREAK STONE TOOL Copper Unlock copper tools → BREAK COPPER TOOL Iron + Gold Unlock iron/gold tools → BREAK IRON TOOL Diamond Unlock diamond tools → BREAK DIAMOND TOOL Netherite Unlock netherite tools ARMOR AGES

title: Hynoe SMP Progression Guide | Campaign, Genesis Ages & Gear
heading: Armor is gated by both patience and accomplishments.
text: Early armor deliberately takes longer than vanilla so reaching a new protection tier feels like an event. START Leather Your baseline armor Age. 10 IN-GAME DAYS Copper Accumulate 240,000 play-time ticks — roughly 3h 20m of playtime. TRIAL SPAWNER Iron + Gold Complete a normal Trial Spawner while wearing copper armor. OMINOUS TRIAL Diamond Complete an Ominous Trial Spawner while wearing iron armor. COMPLETE A RAID Netherite Earn Hero of the Village by completing a raid. SKILL AGES

title: Hynoe SMP Progression Guide | Campaign, Genesis Ages & Gear

title: Hynoe SMP Progression Guide | Campaign, Genesis Ages & Gear
heading: Power should feel earned.
text: Hynoe SMP is balanced around having meaningful goals left weeks and months later. Genesis controls the early unlocks, then the server-specific gear ladder takes over. Power is one road through the world — not a skip button for the rest of it. DEEP PROGRESSION // RARE ORES AHEAD THE HYNOE LOOP

title: Hynoe SMP Progression Guide | Campaign, Genesis Ages & Gear
heading: Seven tiers. Click one to inspect it.
text: The important part is not only what comes next — it is why the previous tier still had time to matter. I Iron → II Diamond → III Netherite → IV Vibranium → V Vulpus → VI Enderium → VII Worldbreaker FOUNDATION

title: Hynoe SMP Progression Guide | Campaign, Genesis Ages & Gear
heading: Smelting
text: Accumulate 120,000 play-time ticks — roughly 1h 40m . This unlocks furnace blocks. ⚔ 25 HOSTILE KILLS

title: Hynoe SMP Progression Guide | Campaign, Genesis Ages & Gear
heading: The End is a checklist, not a shortcut.
text: The major Story Ages can be progressed through their own milestones, but The End stays locked until every required Story Age is complete. NETHER Enchant an item Unlocks access to The Nether. OCEAN Complete an Ocean Monument Unlocks Tridents. PALE Kill a Creaking Counts toward the Story completion required for The End. SCULK Discover Ancient City loot Counts toward the Story completion required for The End. WITHER Kill the Wither Unlocks Enchanted Golden Apples. THE END Complete all Story Ages Unlocks Eyes of Ender and access to The End dimension. WHY THIS EXISTS Hynoe SMP is supposed to have a beginning, middle, and endgame. Genesis prevents a lucky chest, rich friend, or fast mining route from deleting the early game before you have actually played it. GEAR FORGE

title: Hynoe SMP First-Day Guide | Modded Minecraft Survival
heading: Secure the basics.
text: Get wood, food, torches, a bed if possible, and a safe place for storage. Do not panic when familiar recipes or tiers are locked — Genesis is intentionally controlling the early-game pace. WOOD FOOD TORCHES CHEST BED □ LEARN THE LOCKS

title: Hynoe SMP First-Day Guide | Modded Minecraft Survival
heading: Genesis Ages decide what your character is ready for.
text: Tool tiers unlock by actually wearing out the previous tier. Smelting waits for 5 in-game days of playtime. Copper armor waits for 10. Story milestones control major dimension access, including The End. WOOD → STONE → COPPER → IRON → DIAMOND → NETHERITE See every Genesis Age → □ PROGRESS WITHOUT SKIPPING

title: Hynoe SMP First-Day Guide | Modded Minecraft Survival
heading: Build a recovery plan as each Age opens.
text: Keep spare food and unlocked tools at base so one death never erases the whole session. Follow the Genesis tool chain instead of trying to jump straight to iron or diamond, and build armor around the Age your character has actually reached. □ TRAVEL FROM DAY ONE

title: Hynoe SMP First-Day Guide | Modded Minecraft Survival
heading: Use RTP, TPA, and Waystones.
text: /rtp finds new territory. /tpa <player> requests a visit; the other player uses /tpaccept or /tpdeny . Waystones are always unlocked. Save your base coordinates, and check /homes for your available Home slots. □ PROTECT WHAT MATTERS

title: Hynoe SMP First-Day Guide | Modded Minecraft Survival
heading: Plan safe storage and shared builds.
text: Keep spare gear and valuable items organized. Agree on boundaries and access with neighbors and teammates. The old claims system was removed; report griefing or theft to staff. □ LEARN THE NETWORK

text: You do not need to memorize the whole server. Open Minecraft chat and type /help to open the simple guide. When you need an explanation, ask a question. When you need a goal, open your next campaign stage. /help Learn where to start. Open the simple server guide when you first join or need a refresher. /ask <question> Get server guidance. Review the exact stage requirements, see what is left, and use the campaign menu to check and claim. /season Explore the current event. heading: Less guessing. More playing.
text: The handbook is a reference when you need it. Start with help or ask a plain-language question. title: October 1 Player Experience Update | Hynoe SMP
heading: Rewards along the way
text: 151 mission rewards Each tracked campaign requirement gains one-time cash. Together they total $76,150 across all 31 stages. Existing stage payouts remain the larger milestones. 31 stage bundles Every stage gains a one-time themed or utility item bundle. The new bonus is not repeatedly claimable, including on the repeatable endgame stage. $75 / $150 / $300 Visible normal and modded advancements pay by category: Task, Goal, and Challenge. Internal Hynoe technical advancements do not pay. Earlier progress counts The update backtracks completed stages for new mission cash and scans eligible completed advancements once. Reconnecting or rechecking is not intended to pay the same reward again.
